scope: GSD VERIFICATION records for phases 66-77 (incl. 66.2, 66.3, 66.4, 74.1). Docs-only refresh; no product code, no schema DDL.

fields.name: verified
fields.notes: ISO-8601 date the fresh evidence run was recorded

fields.name: status
fields.notes: One of passed, gaps_found, human_needed. Human-only criteria stay in human_verification, never upgrade status.

fields.name: score
fields.notes: Human-readable criterion score with commit evidence

fields.name: covered_files
fields.notes: Every file the verdict covers, including the VERIFICATION file itself

fields.name: covered_digest
fields.notes: v1 sha256 hex over the concatenated bytes of covered_files in listed order. Placeholder strings (e.g. v1:sha256:phase66-verif-20261120) and v3:sha256: prefixes are stale/non-conforming and must be recomputed on refresh (NFR-C2).

fields.name: commits
fields.notes: Short commit ids the evidence ran on

fields.name: gaps
fields.notes: NEW in v1 (additive, optional): exact closing steps per gap; required when status is gaps_found

fields.name: human_verification
fields.notes: NEW in v1 (additive, optional): human-only criteria with evidence and steps, per ADR-0002

compatibility_evidence.result: compatible=true, breaking_count=0, additive=[gaps: new optional field, human_verification: new optional field]
